what_happened.line: Select Board and library trustees could not appoint a library trustee because a quorum of both boards was missing; it was tentatively put on the May 20 agenda.
A motion was made on a renewal bond anticipation note for the school feasibility study; the minutes record the outcome as not audible.
The board decided to send a memo of earth removal control items on the Elmwood Road subdivision to the planning board for its Monday meeting.
The board will schedule a policies workshop and have draft meals tax certificate of good standing language prepared.
The board heard a Lions Club update and committee reports, including building reuse, where the annual operating cost of six properties was discussed.

why_it_matters: The school feasibility study note is short-term borrowing the town renews, so it can carry interest costs paid from the town budget, mostly taxes, until longer-term financing is arranged.
The library trustee seat stays unfilled until both boards can meet with a quorum, and the earth removal and meals tax items touch local development oversight and business compliance rules.
watch_next: May 20 Select Board agenda: library trustee appointment, if a quorum of both boards is present.
The planning board's Monday meeting, where the earth removal memo is due to be sent, and the policies workshop on the meals tax certificate.
